verdicts.quote: allocate up to the smaller of the two counts, rechecking at each commit. ... Duplicate or stale work cannot create a second booking, move a different entry, or displace a committed booking.
Waitlist actions cannot introduce a booking in excess of authoritative capacity or an active waitlist entry alongside a confirmed booking for the same booker and instance.
